transcript: Hello Haan Oh very good afternoon sir, yeh Baba distributors se meri baat ho rahi hai na? Yes ma'am Aa ji sir main India Mart team se baat kar rahi thi actually aapka ek business profile register tha uspe kaafi inquiries vagairah aa rahi thi basically aap log ka sir beauty product pe aap log deal kar rahe ho kya Theek hai Nahi nahi beauty product nahi hai ma'am milunga Okay toh sir kyonki yahan pe toh sir beauty services aur sunscreen skin creams wagairah mention nahi nahi Nahi nahi nahi nahi vo sab ka toh kaam hum karte nahi hai madam Okay toh vo sir kis cheez pe abhi deal kar rahe ho aap Hum refine oil ka kaam karte hain ma'am Okay jaise ki sir maine abhi bataya yahan pe aapke jo products hai vo mismatch kar rahe hai, theek hai? To iski wajah se kya ho raha hai na jo yahan product mention hai usi pe log inquiry generate kar rahe hai, to aap ek baar time dete sir to hum log ye cheez ko aake ek baar correct kar dete aur kya hota ki phir jo jis product pe aap deal kar rahe ho wo sari cheeze update kar dete na to phir hamare site se jo bhi aapko inquiries aati to aap vo check kar paate aur uspe aap deal kar paate, theek hai? Aur jaise hum aapko pata hoga Endamart ek B2B platform hai to hamare site se inquiries leads kaafi achhi receive hoti hai. Ma'am kya hai na ki aapke yahan tak maan lijiye yahan se chaalis kilometer door order aa gaya toh hum supply nahi kar payenge ma'am. Nahi sir iska poora aapke oopar depend karta hai filter ka option agar aap location uspe option rehta hai filter mein location ka to aap apne near by mein agar seal karna chahte ho to aapne near by select karo aur aap hamare paas poore pan India ka access rehta hai na to aapke oopar depend karta hai aap kahan tak deal karna chah rahe ho Ji sir, jaise ki abhi aapne yeh question kiya sir, obviously isse yahi pata chal raha hai ki abhi aapko India Part ke proper services ke baare mein utni knowledge nahi hai. Isliye main chah rahi hoon sir ki dekhiye sir, package lena nahi lena woh different thing hai, but aapko pehle services kya hai hamare, hum log kaise aapke business growth mein help karenge woh saari cheezein clear rahegi, tabhi toh aap bhi aage kuch plan kar paoge. Isliye agar aap time dete sir, toh hum log cheezein baith ke ek baar clear kar lete hain. Agar aapko lagta hai yeh aapke liye beneficial hai, no doubt yeh beneficial hoga, but ek baar aap samajh loge tab aapko samajh aayegi ki kaise beneficial hoga. Toh phir iske liye hum log... Aage proceed karenge toh ek baar time deke abhi toh sir se aapka product hi mismatches hai aap agar app bhi rakhe honge toh usmein aapko inquiries bhi aati hogi toh aap khud sochte hoge yeh toh inquiry different aa rahi hai aap jis product par deal kar rahe ho uski inquiry hi nahi aa rahi hai toh aapko lagta hoga ki toh yeh toh matlab sahi chal hi nahi raha hai toh yahi hota hai cheezen bhi clear nahi hai sab toh ek baar cheezen clear karne ke liye time de dete hain uske baad ki cheezen hum log aage discuss karte hain Theek hai na, hum soch ke aapko batate hain ma'am. Abhi toh real recent mein mera koi program nahi hai film karane ka. Kuchh hota toh hum baat karte hain aapse. Haan Kuchh No doubt sir, aapka matlab no problem sir, aapka koi vaisa program nahi hai, jaise aapka yeh Ratu Road ka address yahan pe mention tha, toh aapka address wahi kahan hai? Nahi upper bazaar aa gaya hai maan lo. Oh ab lagta hai sir aapka pehle yeh cosmetic ka business chal raha tha kya Pehle Lotus ka kaam hum kar rahe the bahut pehle das saal pehle pandrah saal pehle. Kyonki mere ko lag raha hai usi cheez ka update tha sir yahan pe koi issue nahi hai sir upper bazaar ke to bahut saare customer hain jo India Mart se achhi services le rahe hain aap ek baar sir cheezen samajh lo baith ke uske baad aap decide kar lena kya time lena hai ya jo bhi but cheezen samajhne ke liye ek baar time de dete to zyada achha rehta sir agar cheezen nahi bhi to kam se kam profile update kara lete sir ki usse aapki visibility badhti kam se kam customer connect kar paate hain aapse Kyonki usmein sir kuch meeting mein jo enrichment hoti hai usmein toh koi charges nahi lagte bas das pandrah minute ka time lagta hai team jaati hai aapko cheezein explain karti hai aapka profile update kar deti hai uske baad aap ek do din observe karna ki kaisi leads aa rahi hai kaise customers aa rahe hain uske baad phir aap uske liye aage proceed kar sakte ho ek baar time loge tab toh sir hamare site hamare site se bhi aapko cheezein clear ho payegi Theek hai na ma'am samajh ke batate hain. Okay okay jaise upper bazaar mein abhi hamara visit tha sir matlab team udhar thi toh agar teen chaar baje ke around aap free rehte the Nahi ma'am teen chaar baje toh hum Rajkot bazaar mein rehte hain hamara pandrah chal jaate hain. Okay okay achha yaani aap first half mein hi available rehte ho sir Haan haan haan Okay no issue sir ek baar try karte hain kal ke liye hum log kyonki upper bazaar mein humare jaise maine bataya humare bahut saare customers hain to upper bazaar ka lagbhag daily visit hota hai to agar first half mein kal aap free rahoge to ek baar pandrah paas minute ka time nikaal ke team ke saath baith ke cheezein hum log enrichment kar lete hain profile ki ek baar morning mein main connect kar loongi aap agar free rahoge to Theek hai na Ma'am Okay sure sir theek hai but time mein zaroor nikaliyeega Hoon hoon Thank you sir
